Agent profile TOML schema and builtins

label: Project config discovery looks for .vibe/config.toml from the working directory upward, nearest first, stops at VIBE_HOME's parent, and applies only when the directory is trusted.
The project-local directory set is fixed and root-only: .vibe/tools, .vibe/skills, .vibe/plugins, .vibe/agents, .vibe/prompts, .vibe/config.toml, plus .agents/skills.

The global home is $VIBE_HOME with tools, skills, plugins, agents, prompts, skills-registry-cache, AGENTS.md and config.toml, plus ~/.agents/skills; VIBE_HOME is environment-overridable so a dispatch can leave the operator home untouched.

AGENTS.md is read from $VIBE_HOME and from every directory from the working directory up to its trust root, outermost first so nearer entries win, with subdirectory AGENTS.md injected lazily when a file below the root is read.

An agent profile is TOML with name, display_name, description, safety, agent_type, overrides and instructions; builtins are ask, accept-edits, smart-approve, auto-approve, explore and lean, and the name main is reserved and rejected.
A plugin is a plugin.json manifest on the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema with an ai.mistral.vibe extension block, and it may ship skills; the built-in vibe plugin ships five skills.

The repository already carries seven runtime mirrors each with a SYNC.md classifying every surface as hand-authored, derived or generated; .dsh/SYNC.md section 2 is the closest template for a .vibe/ mirror.

direction: Assuming Vibe reads a repo-root config file by default
reason: Discovery walks up to the trust root and an untrusted directory's .vibe/config.toml does not apply.
Local config discovery examines only the project root, so nested .vibe folders are invisible.

label: A repo-root .vibe/ mirror only takes effect when the working directory is trusted, so trust must be established by the dispatch rather than assumed.
